prs.title: [cssom-view-1] Give "determine the device pixel ratio" a Document parameter
prs.author: noamr
prs.body:
Parameterize the exported [determine the device pixel ratio](https://drafts.csswg.org/cssom-view-1/#determine-the-device-pixel-ratio) algorithm to take a `Document` parameter (`document`), using `document`'s current page zoom, and update the `Window.devicePixelRatio` getter to pass `this`'s associated `Document`.

This allows callers in other specifications (such as HTML's [select an image source from a source set](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/13183)) to invoke `determine the device pixel ratio` for a given `Document`.
